verdict.rationale: Copilot supports natural-language chat/agent-mode across IDEs, terminal (CLI), and cloud agents, letting users direct tasks like 'fix the bug' or 'edit files' via NL commands (github-copilot-docs-2,3,4,5,22, probe-4). Community evidence corroborates real-world use of chat-driven coding assistance, though some hands-on critiques note NL commands can be vague/unreliable in practice. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command reliability/accuracy and broader cross-editor parity confirmation.
